about: The spec for SparkBox Help. Article files live at docs/help/<file>. toc gives the order of the table of contents, helpMenu the macOS Help menu (an entry with toc stands for that whole section of the table of contents, and one with section opens its page), windowHelp and settingsHelp the article behind each window's and Settings section's info button. verified: true = proven on the owner's cluster; false = test systems only, the Help window shows one calm line; null = doesn't touch the cluster, no line. proof, where present, is a fact the article states in one plain sentence.
calmLine: Built and tested on test systems. Not yet proven on your cluster.

seedExample.note: The help-system builder seeds these two so writers can copy the pattern. The owning writer replaces them with the finished text.
